thread:
jules: noticed a burst of tiny gpu jobs Pending in apse2-b. Many have `nodeAffinity: nvlink=true` and `podAntiAffinity` to avoid co-locating. cluster-autoscaler didn't add nodes fast enough so scheduler is thrashing.
henry: yep, autoscaler log shows scale-up requests capped by quota check. apse2 quotas are at 92%.
anita: also seeing a pattern: warmpool attachments are serializing PV mounts because of our artifact store rate limit, so nodes stay in NotReady longer.
jules: here's the scheduler trace snippet:
```
E0402 09:14:02 scheduler.go:233] trySchedule: candidate nodes=12, combinations=~1.6e6, memory=1.8GB
E0402 09:14:02 solver.go:88] search exceeded nodeCap -> backoff
E0402 09:14:03 scheduler.go:241] fallback to heuristic packing, preempting tiny-gpu-ml-*.
```
rade: that "combinations" blowup is us respecting strict anti-affinity + nvlink preference. The exact combinatorial explosion.
henry: quick mitigation: relax podAntiAffinity to preferred during the incident window. We can flip `affinity.weight` to lower for small jobs via mutating webhook.
anita: we should also adjust autoscaler headroom temporarily (scaleDownDisabled + lower threshold) so capacity is available quickly.
jules: I'm worried about cost — relaxing anti-affinity will pack GPUs and increase noisy-neighbor risk. How many slots will that affect?
henry: estimates: if we pack tiny pods, GPU utilization up ~18% but mean tail latency for big training jobs might increase 10-15% during the window.
ops-bot: Incident created: INC-2024-8379 severity=high assigned to eng-platform.
rade: Proposed immediate plan: 1) enable webhook override to lower anti-affinity weight for pods with label `job-size: small` 2) disable scale-down in apse2 for 20m 3) apply a canary of 5 nodes with relaxed taints in one AZ.
anita: I'll patch the autoscaler config now and open the webhook change as quick rollbackable flag.
jules: doing canary: `kubectl label node node-apse2b-03 canary=pack && kubectl taint nodes node-apse2b-03 dedicated-ml:NoSchedule-`
henry: After 12m: pending tiny jobs dropped from 78 to 9. Warmpool attach backlog dropped after I bumped concurrent artifact fetches from 8->20 per node.
rade: Follow-up items: - schedule a compaction job to binpack long-running small inference containers overnight - add metrics on solver combination count and memory - revisit label taxonomy, avoid overly strict nvlink-only affinity for ephemeral workloads.
jules: I'll draft a short playbook for next time: steps to relax affinity, autoscaler knobs, and artifact throttle.
anita: filing PR to make artifact concurrency configurable per node - link in channel when ready.
henry: reassigning cost impact to finance for a short-term +9% infra delta if we keep relaxed packing for >2h.
jules: good work everyone. We'll keep canary until end of day and then revert webhook if stable. :rocket:
